name: Kirby Café
intro: Kirby-themed cafés serving dishes shaped like Kirby and his friends. Reservations open once a month, you need an account to book, and each account can make up to three reservations per store per month.

facts.bookAhead: Next month's bookings open on the 10th

statusNote: The official site confirms bookings open on the 10th for the following month. The 18:00 start time is from travel sources; the official site does not state it.
popularityNote: Keyword data (Oct 2025 to Sep 2026): "kirby cafe reservation" about 5,000 searches a month, with no other related searches.
difficultyNote: The official site says bookings are hard to get right after they open (high traffic). That weekday slots remain later is our estimate.
bookingSteps: Open the reservation page for your store (Tokyo, Osaka or Hakata) from the official Kirby Café site. It is in Japanese, so use your browser’s translate feature.
Create an account with an email address and a phone number. You verify the number by calling a number from that phone.
At release time, choose a date, a time and the number of people: up to 8 in Tokyo and Hakata, 6 in Osaka.
Keep the reservation-completion email. You show it at the door.
Arrive 10 minutes before your time with ID for the person who booked.
visitorTips: The official FAQ doesn't say whether an overseas phone number can be verified.
You can book up to three times a month at each store.
Your booking is cancelled if you're more than 10 minutes late. Tables are yours for 85 minutes, including payment.
The booker must be one of the visitors. Transferred or resold bookings are void.
Cancel online in My Page until the day before. On the day, call the store.

soldOut.label: Pokémon Café: the whole next month opens on the 1st

faq.q: When do Kirby Café reservations open?
faq.a: On the 10th of each month, for the whole of the next month. Travel sources report an 18:00 Japan time start; the official site gives the date but not the time.

sources.quote: 2026年8月分（2026年7月10日予約開始）より、ご予約にはアカウント登録が必要となります。
東京と福岡は、毎月10日、18:00に翌月の受付がスタートします。
Reservations open at 6 pm Japan Time on the 10th of each month.
もしご予約時間から10分を過ぎてもご来店いただけない場合は、キャンセルとさせていただきます。
Kirby Café will check your ID when you visit the store, and if you are not the person who made the reservation, you will not be allowed to enter the store.
